== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Archlord]] [[soulfire]] represents the highest level of [[soulfire]]. It is characterized by a blue-white appearance and has a consistency similar to quicksilver. This form of energy is used in the peak of traditional [[Soulsmithing]] to create artifacts, and even when tempering high-level remnants like those of a [[Monarch]] or [[Herald]], the resulting weapon is only slightly superior to one made with actual [[Archlord]] [[soulfire]]. Beyond crafting, it serves various functional roles: it can be used to refine a practitioner's [[spirit]], bones, and organs; it can support the process of physical and spiritual transformation; and it can be utilized to influence or manipulate the [[aura]] of a mind. Additionally, it can be woven into techniques to create [[destruction]] auras or used to empower specific abilities, such as black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath, which can melt through defenses with ease.}}
